_scope: PILOT SET — 26 queries over the 18 distinct passages currently in backend/chroma_data. Every relevant_chunk_ids value was read off the actual indexed text, so this runs today and is a real smoke test of the four retrieval arms. It is NOT the set for the paper: the indexed corpus is a dogs guide plus a STRIDE assignment, not lecture material, and 18 passages cannot support the 80-120 queries a retrieval table needs. Ingest the real lecture PDFs, run --corpus-stats to confirm the duplication is gone, then rebuild this file with --dump-chunks.

files: All About Dogs_ A Complete Guide.pdf
_corpus_at_annotation.note: chunk ids are content-addressed (sha:<md5 of first 200 normalised chars>), so the 16.6x duplication collapses to one id per passage.

_chunking_note: The ingestion pipeline uses a sliding window, so consecutive passages overlap. Where an answer straddles a boundary both chunks are listed as relevant — marking only one would penalise a retriever that returned the equally-valid neighbour.
